description.value: Beginning at 5th level, the medic can prepare injections to enhance herself and her allies. The medic can prepare a number of injections equal to half her medic level + her Wisdom modifier per day. Most medics create syringes at the start of the day and it takes an hour to prepare. All injections have a duration of 1 minute and become inert if not used the day they were created. After the duration is over, recipients are fatigued for twice that time; receiving another injection while fatigued makes them exhausted instead. It takes a standard action to use, but the medic can hand out injections. Available injections: Adrenaline Shot (Haste status), Feline Vision (low-light vision, +4 competence bonus to Perception), Mental Boost (+2 alchemical bonus to Int/Wis/Cha), Physical Boost (+2 alchemical bonus to Str/Dex/Con), Regenerative Serum (Fast Healing 2).
